label: Santa Monica

county_election_office.name: Los Angeles County Registrar-Recorder/County Clerk (LAVote.gov), 12400 Imperial Hwy, Norwalk

zip_caveats: Santa Monica's ZIPs are 90401 to 90405. ZIP 90402 is shared with the City of Los Angeles: most of it is Santa Monica, but Santa Monica Canyon, just past the city's northern edge, is in LA, so the guide asks which one you live in. A thin edge of 90405 next to Venice is in LA too. Everyone in the city votes in the same races. All of Santa Monica is in U.S. House District 36 (the 2025 map), State Senate District 24 and Assembly District 51, and in the Santa Monica-Malibu Unified and Santa Monica College districts, which Malibu voters elect too. Santa Monica has five city measures this year: ES, GG, RR, VV and TT. Measure ES is a school parcel tax that the city would collect, so Malibu voters don't see it. There's no race for county supervisor here this year. Your sample ballot at isb.lavote.gov shows your exact ballot.

situations.short: Get a replacement at any LA County vote center or just vote there.
situations.answer: The last day to ask for a ballot by mail was October 27. You can still go to any LA County vote center and ask for a replacement or vote there in person. Questions? Call (800) 815-2666, press 2, then 3.
steps: Use the county's locator to find a vote center near you.
